statement.text: A queue-balancing pattern from the source domain transfers as a functional equivalent to the target domain.

sources.passage: Load is redistributed among interchangeable workers when one worker is saturated.
Each target worker owns non-transferable state and cannot hand work to another worker.

uncertainty.description: Other narrower relational correspondences were not evaluated in this fixture.

assumptions: Transfer requires workers in the target domain to be substitutable during redistribution.
competing_hypotheses: Only a surface or relational analogy transfers; functional equivalence does not.

counterexamples: A target worker with non-transferable state cannot be replaced by another worker without loss of continuity.
